line: Crowley's Four of Cups is the card for the third decan of Cancer, with the Moon as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Cancer.

quotes.quote: The Four of Cups is called Luxury.
The card refers to the Moon in Cancer, which is her own house

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: This card refers to Chesed in the sphere of Water.
